title: Three spooky tales from Chester most haunted pub courtesy of the Old King's Head
excerpt: ON THIS Halloween, we’ve called on the help of our friends at the Old King’s Head to tell their spookiest stories at the famously haunted pub.
content:
ON THIS Halloween, we’ve called on the help of our friends at the Old King’s Head to tell their spookiest stories at the famously haunted pub.

Many thanks to Harry Achilleos from My Haunted Hotel for these three tales.

The Tragic Tale of Billy and Sarah – The Children Who Never Left

One of the most heartbreaking stories associated with the Old King's Head is that of two young children, Billy and Sarah, whose spirits are believed to still wander the building, desperately searching for their parents.

Over the years, guests and staff have reported hearing children crying, footsteps running along empty corridors and unexplained knocking on bedroom doors.

According to local legend, the story dates back to the 18th century, when the property was home to a husband, his wife and their two young children.

However, behind closed doors, a secret affair was unfolding that would ultimately destroy the family.

The wife is said to have fallen in love with a gentleman who lived across the road and operated a doll shop.

Each day, she would stand at the window of what is now Room Four, waiting for a discreet signal from her lover before the pair would meet in secret.

Although they believed their relationship had gone unnoticed, the woman's husband allegedly knew about the affair all along.

In an era when adultery was considered deeply scandalous, the betrayed husband is said to have taken matters into his own hands, murdering his wife's lover without her knowledge.

Unaware of the tragedy, the wife continued to wait at the window for the familiar signal that never came.

As the days passed, she began to suspect something terrible had happened.

According to the legend, the devastating discovery left her so overcome with grief that she took her own life in the River Dee.

Her husband is then said to have abandoned the family home, leaving Billy and Sarah behind.

It is this tragic ending that some believe explains the unexplained activity still reported within the building today.

The sounds of children crying, running along corridors and knocking on doors are believed by some to be the restless spirits of Billy and Sarah, forever searching for the parents who never returned.

More than two centuries later, their story remains one of the Old King's Head's most haunting legends.

The Shadow Figure – A Mysterious Visitor from the 17th Century

Of the 13 spirits said to inhabit the Old King's Head, few are as widely reported or as mysterious as the shadow figure.

The Old Kings Head in Chester. (Image: Old Kings Head.)

Described as a tall, dark, humanoid silhouette, the figure has allegedly been witnessed by guests, staff and former landlords over several decades.

For Harry, one particularly chilling encounter in 2014 changed his understanding of the building forever.

During what began as an ordinary poker night, Harry and a member of staff were in the bar when a mysterious black figure reportedly appeared and walked directly between them.

The encounter was accompanied by a piercing, high-pitched shriek and a sudden, intense drop in temperature.

It was the first time Harry had personally witnessed the shadow figure that so many others had described to him.

Until that moment, the stories had been accounts passed on by guests and former occupants.

Now, he had experienced something he could not explain.

Over the years, visitors have claimed to see the same dark figure standing at the foot of their beds, moving through bedrooms or appearing unexpectedly in the corridors.

Some have even reported capturing what they believe to be the mysterious apparition on their mobile phones.

These repeated encounters helped convince Harry that cameras needed to be installed throughout the property in an attempt to document the unexplained activity.

According to one theory, the shadow figure could be the spirit of a soldier from the English Civil War in the 17th century.

Sightings have been reported in the cellar and bedrooms, although the figure is said to appear most frequently on the first floor, an area historically associated with the building's alleged use as a brothel.

This has led to an intriguing question among those investigating the haunting: is the mysterious visitor simply returning for a pint, or is he still searching for the ladies of the night?

Perhaps most fascinating is that reports of the figure are not confined to recent years.

During filming for the Amazon series My Haunted Hotel, the team invited former landlords who had run the property during the 1960s and 1970s to share their experiences.

According to Harry, each recalled encounters with the mysterious shadow figure and described unexplained incidents remarkably similar to those still being reported today.

Their accounts raise an intriguing question.

If people were witnessing the same phenomena more than half a century ago, long before modern paranormal television programmes and investigations, what exactly were they experiencing?

For those who believe the Old King's Head is haunted, the shadow figure remains one of its most compelling mysteries.

My Haunted Hotel – When the Guests Aren't the Only Ones Staying

For ten years, Harry ran the Old King's Head as a conventional hotel, welcoming guests who expected little more than a comfortable room and a peaceful night's sleep.

However, it soon became apparent that some visitors believed they were sharing the building with something they could neither see nor explain.

Harry regularly found himself dealing with complaints, unexpected departures and letters from frightened guests explaining why they had left during the night.

Room Three became particularly notorious.

Guests reported waking to find a dark figure hovering above their beds, while others described hearing children crying in the bathroom despite no children being present.

Elsewhere in the building, visitors complained of footsteps running along empty corridors, cupboard doors opening without explanation and loud bangs echoing through otherwise silent rooms.

Some reported hearing whispers directly in their ears, while others claimed that personal belongings had mysteriously moved during the night.

The Old Kings Head in Chester. (Image: Old Kings Head.)

Perhaps among the most disturbing accounts were those involving bedcovers.

Several guests described waking in the early hours to find their covers being pulled tightly around their bodies by an unseen force.

According to some accounts, the sensation would continue until the frightened guest demanded that whatever was responsible should stop, at which point the pressure would suddenly release.

For Harry, these incidents became increasingly difficult to dismiss.

What had begun as an ordinary hospitality business was gradually becoming a place where reports of unexplained activity were part of everyday life.

Today, the Old King's Head is home to My Haunted Hotel, a paranormal investigation project that allows visitors to experience the building and its mysterious reputation for themselves.

Unlike a traditional hotel, the property is now equipped with approximately 30 cameras positioned throughout the building, allowing the team to monitor and record unusual incidents.

For paranormal enthusiasts, it offers an opportunity to spend time inside a location with a long history of reported hauntings.

And according to those involved, the activity has only intensified with the introduction of Stumpy.

But the strange occurrences are not limited to the bedrooms.

Downstairs in the pub, staff have reportedly witnessed pints of beer inexplicably flying from tables, leaving customers startled and drinks spilled across the floor.

One particular table, positioned opposite the bar beside the window, has become especially well known for these incidents.

Harry says it happens so regularly that the pub has often reimbursed customers for drinks that have seemingly been knocked from the table by an unseen force.

Whether these incidents have a paranormal explanation or not, they have become part of the extraordinary reputation surrounding the Old King's Head.

For Harry and the team behind My Haunted Hotel, the aim is to document what happens inside the building and allow visitors to draw their own conclusions.

With centuries of history, numerous eyewitness accounts and cameras recording throughout the property, the Old King's Head continues to attract those hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

And for those brave enough to spend the night, there is always the possibility that their most memorable encounter might not be with another guest.
